basic_profile.bio: I'm a high school student from California, just getting started with Reddit. I love gaming, especially Minecraft and anything related to YouTube drama. Not really into heavy reading, so I spend most of my time online watching videos or chatting with friends. My typical online hours are after school and late evenings. I'm single and just navigating through high school life, looking for fun and interesting stuff online. I'm also curious about Asian cultures, especially Thai shows.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm mostly self-taught when it comes to technology and online platforms. I learned about Reddit through friends who are into gaming and social media. I have a basic understanding of how these platforms work but still exploring and learning new things every day.
